sham_diagnostic.note: sham≈mean -> nonspecific perturbation response (CONVERGENT diagnostic only; does NOT prove non-partner-specificity — the PPT sham does not reproduce the AG channel exactly)

symmetry_diagnostic.note: reported diagnostic (tautological with ΔC dispersion), NOT a gate

partner_specific_contrast.note: ΔC_specific = ΔC_partner - ΔC_sham (paired); rigorous partner-specificity test. CI-includes-0 => nonspecific.

dispersion_secondary.caveat: PPT sham cannot exclude AG-channel state-dependent damage

run_type: outcome_aware_deterministic_verification (ΔC seen on v7 pre-v8; NOT confirmatory)

REFLECTION.verdict: small_but_detectable_sub_SESOI_effect; NO evidence for a meaningful PARTNER-SPECIFIC effect
REFLECTION.conclusion: IC1 found a small average effect of conservative distal rearrangement, +0.032 nats [+0.012,+0.053], BELOW the preregistered material-effect threshold (0.05) and closely reproduced by the non-partner sham. It therefore provides NO evidence for a meaningful partner-specific effect in the tested (conservative-constructible, L>=107) subdomain.
REFLECTION.partner_specific_contrast: ΔC_specific = ΔC_partner - ΔC_sham = +0.006, CI95(BCa)[-0.011,+0.024] INCLUDES 0 -> the partner-specific component is indistinguishable from zero. This paired contrast (not 'sham≈mean') is the rigorous support for nonspecificity.
REFLECTION.primary: signed ΔC̄=+0.032, CI[+0.012,+0.053], excludes 0 but < SESOI 0.05; achieved MDE 0.029 (well-powered). Classification: small-but-detectable sub-SESOI.
REFLECTION.gates: all pass: corrected distal_ood noninferiority (cons in-band 0.994 >= nat 0.950 - δ0.044); conservative_construction; sensitivity_onpath; native_coupling 0.614; n_clusters 256.
REFLECTION.secondary: dispersion excess-over-sham +0.025 (CI[+0.015,+0.037], reported only, cannot exclude AG-channel damage); cryptic-competition arm-contrasts null.
REFLECTION.reproducibility: deterministic cohort (259 introns/256 clusters) under sorted-set shuffler + pinned PYTHONHASHSEED; determinism test PASSES across HASHSEED {0,1,2,17}. v8 reproduces v7 exactly (+0.032).
REFLECTION.status_note: ΔC seen on v7 before the v8 fixes -> VERIFICATION not confirmatory; a publication-grade null needs a genuinely untouched disjoint cohort.
REFLECTION.next: Acceptor-competition study (PREREGISTRATION_IC2_ACCEPTOR_COMPETITION.md); then transfer to a 2nd GFM. IC2a proximal-decomposition drafted but NOT PURSUED.
